content.text: Fɛlɛ tɛkɛ, asa n gupua mↄ̀,
Dii gawi pìsima.
Gwa! Guluuluu kù dṹniaa,
gusia kùlɛ a gbɛ̃́ↄwa.
Mpi sↄ̃, Dii a bilɛma,
aà gawi i bↄma.
Buiↄ mↄ n gupuau,
kíaↄ sↄ̃ n pípia í gbãai.
Wɛzu gugwa ǹ liai,
aa kã̀aa píi, aalɛ mↄ́ n kĩ́i.
N nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ bↄ̀ za zã̀zã, aalɛ su,
wa n nɛnↄɛↄ naaa ń gbã̀tɛ̃ɛu, wàlɛ suńnↄ.
Tó n bee è, n pↄna a pisi n oawa,
n nↄ̀sɛ a yáalↄ kua nzĩa dakĩiwa.
Wa n gba ísia baa àizɛɛↄ,
wa mↄnɛ ń buiↄ pↄmaaↄ.
Yiongo waiↄ li n bùsua,
Madiã ń Efa bùsu yiongo nɛ́ bↄlↄↄ.
Seba bùsudeↄ mↄ píi
vua ń tulaleti gĩnanaↄ sɛa,
aalɛ ma yãkɛaↄ baokpa.
Wa Kedaa bùsu pↄtuoↄ kãaanɛ píi,
wa Nɛbaioↄ sãsaↄ kpama ǹ n bↄↄlɛkɛò,
wi sa pↄ́ ì kamagu oò ma gbagbakĩiwa,
mí a kpɛ́ gawide gawi kã́fĩò.
Bↄ́mɛ táa'ò lɛ́ su lán louwa,
lán felenguuluↄ sua ń kpɛ́uwa keei?
Ísiabaadeↄ lɛ́ kãaamazi we,
ísia gó'ilɛnaↄ mɛ́ zɛmikũa we.
Aa bↄ̀ ń n nɛ́ↄ za zã̀zã,
aalɛ mↄ́ ń ń ã́nusuↄ ń ń vuaↄ
ma Dii n Lua tↄbↄi,
asa ma Isailiↄ Lua ma kua adoaɛ,
má gawi pisima.
Buipãleↄ ɛa n bĩ́iↄ bo,
an kíaↄ zĩkɛnɛ.
Baa kɛ́ ma n gbɛ̃ ń pↄfɛ̃o yãa,
má wɛ̃nadↄ̃nɛ ma sùuu yã́i sa.
N bĩ́ibↄlɛↄ aaↄ wɛ̃aɛ gↄↄpii,
aaliↄ taao fãanɛ ń gwãasĩnao,
kɛ́ buiↄ mↄnɛ ń ń àizɛɛↄ
ń ń kíaↄ kpán'aɛkɛa.
Asa bui ge kpala pↄ́ i zↄblenɛo a midɛɛ,
wa ń bùsuↄ dɛɛlɛmpa míↄmiↄ.
Wa mↄnɛ ń Libã bùsu gawio,
pɛ̃liↄ ń kpɛ̃liↄ ń sɛ̃́liↄ píi,
kɛ́ mà e zãbleò ma kúkĩiwa,
ma gbadibↄpi iↄ gawi vĩ.
N wɛtãna nɛ́ↄ mↄ kúlɛnɛ,
gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ aa sakàngupiↄ wúlɛnɛ n gbázĩ,
aai onɛ Dii wɛ̃́lɛ
Siↄna pↄ́ Isailiↄ Lua pↄ́ a kua adoa kàlɛ.
Baa kɛ́ gbɛ̃́ↄ zàngu yãa
aa pãkpànzi,
gbɛ̃eli gu baavĩ n guuo,
má n kɛ ĩ́andãbↄ láasai ũ,
gbɛ̃́ↄ iↄ pↄnakɛò e ń buiwa.
Ńyↄ̃ buiↄ vĩ mi,
an kíaↄ yↄ̃́ kpama,
níↄ dↄ̃ mámɛ máa Dii n Suabana ũ,
Yakↄbu Lua gbãade n Bona ũ.
Má mↄ́ ń vuao mↄgotɛ̃ gbɛu,
ã́nusu sↄ̃ mↄsi gbɛu.
Má mↄ́ ń mↄgotɛ̃oli gbɛu,
mↄsi sↄ̃ gbɛ gbɛu.
Má aafia dilɛnɛ n laaidↄmade ũ,
má yã́zɛde danɛ n gbãade ũ.
Wa yãpãsĩ súu ma n bùsuu lↄo,
ásoo ń músio a sↄ̃ n bùsu zↄ̃lɛio.
Wa tↄ́kpa n bĩ́iɛ Suaba,
n bↄlɛↄ sↄ̃ Táasi.
Ĩatɛ̃ ali gupunɛ fãanɛ lↄo,
mↄvua í gbãa a gupunɛ lↄo.
Ma Dii mámɛ máↄ dɛ n gupua ũ gↄↄpii,
mapi n Lua, mámɛ máↄ dɛ n tɛkɛa ũ.
N ĩatɛ̃ a gɛ̃ kpɛ́u bauo,
mɛ́ n mↄ a ↄsikɛo,
asa mámɛ máↄ dɛ n gupua láasai ũ,
n ↄↄlↄ a midɛ sa.
N gbɛ̃́ↄ aaↄ maa píiɛ,
mɛ́ aaↄ bùsu vĩ gↄↄpii.
Aaↄ dɛ lí pↄ́ má bà vlãpaa ũ,
ma ↄgbɛ ũ ma zãblea yã́i.
An gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ kɛ̃́sãańzi
a kↄ̃ à ka gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aa sↄo,
an gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ kpɛɛ ń guu,
a gↄ̃ bui zↄ̃ↄ ũ.
Mámɛmaa Dii,
má yã́pi kɛ a gↄↄwa ń wãao.
